name: Becker Farms and Vizcarra Vineyards
description: Becker Farms and Vizcarra Vineyards is an agritourism farm in 3724 Quaker Rd, NY, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
